name: fynxt-design-code-station
description: FYNXT Design Code Station: shared tokens, component library, templates and FDI Studio. Governed by fynxt-product-experience-engine.

scripts.dev: npm run tokens:build && npm run dev -w @fynxt/studio
scripts.build: npm run tokens:build && npm run build -w @fynxt/studio
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/ui && tsc -p packages/templates && tsc -p apps/studio && tsc -p apps/studio/tsconfig.server.json
